ns:interface.documentation:
Interface to carryout the CRUD (maintenance) operations of a bank detail object
		For all the update methods, it is expected that the client calls the "fetch"
		method first and submit the modified bank detail record appropriately.

method.documentation:
fetch:

			Inputs: 
				org_id and acct_identifier of the bank_detail (mandatory)

			Outputs:
				bank_detail object of the given org_id and acct_identifier

			Description:
				Retrieves a bank_detail object for the given org_id and acct_identifier

			Errors:
				Throws errors in case of invalid or missing inputs
				Throws errors in case the bank_detail record does not exist
method.name: fetch

method.documentation:
add:

			Inputs:
				bank_detail 
			Outputs:
				None

			Description:
				Adds a new bank_detail object

			Errors:
				Throws errors in case of invalid or missing inputs
				Throws errors in case the bank_detail record already exists
method.name: add

method.documentation:
modify:

			Inputs:
				bank_detail of the given acct_identifier

			Outputs:
				None

			Description:
				Update a bank_detail object in the Subscriber database

			Errors:
				Throws errors in case of invalid or missing inputs
				Throws errors in case the bank_detail record does not exist
method.name: modify

method.documentation:
delete:

			Inputs:
				bank_detail object of the given acct_identifier

			Outputs:
				None

			Description:
				Marks a bank_detail object in the Subscriber database as deleted

			Errors:
				Throws errors in case of invalid or missing inputs
				Throws errors in case the bank_detail record does not exists
method.name: delete

method.documentation:
undelete:

			Inputs:
				bank_detail object of the given acct_identifier

			Outputs:
				None

			Description:
				Marks a bank_detail object in the Subscriber database as not deleted

			Errors:
				Throws errors in case of invalid or missing inputs
				Throws errors in case the order record does not exist
method.name: undelete

method.documentation:
list:

			Inputs:
				query_params with one or all of
                acct_identifier,acct_name,acct_number,bank_identifier_type,bank_identifier


			Outputs:
				List of bank_detail objects matching the given input criteria

			Description:
				Queries the database and retrives a list of matching bank_detail records

			Errors:
				Throws errors in case of invalid or missing inputs
method.name: list

ns:interface.name: bank_detail
